concerns.text: T002 builds simulation boxes of '~150 molecules', while the plan (Phase 1, step 4) and research.md specify '≈ 300 molecules/solvent (≈ 10 k atoms)'. This is a silent relaxation of a planned constraint that directly affects the Yeh–Hummer finite-size correction (T003) and the comparability of results to the documented protocol. Either restore ≈300 molecules or record an explicit, justified amendment in the plan — not a quiet change in the task.

concerns.text: T009 verifies with 'python code/pipeline.py --full', but quickstart.md and plan.md Phase 6 document 'main.py --full-batch' / 'pipeline.py --full-batch'. The verified command and the documented command differ, so FR-009/SC-006 (end-to-end execution of the *defined* workflow) is verified against a command that is not the documented one. Align the flag/entry point across tasks and quickstart.
